reserves.name: River satUSD collateral basket (BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: River protocol user-deposited BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid-staking-token collateral

reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29: River's FAQ and product material state that satUSD is over-collateralized by BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens, with collateral remaining on source chains. River publishes no current satUSD-specific category weights, vault-level inventory, or reserve attestation. Aggregate protocol TVL pages are not used to infer satUSD composition because they can include non-satUSD positions. The reserve is therefore retained as one explicit cryptoasset basket with a full unresolved composition disposition.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: River issuer collateral disclosures; no satUSD-specific dated reserve composition
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Current weights among BTC, ETH, BNB, and liquid staking tokens, vault-level collateral identity, and custody allocation are undisclosed.
